hooks.description: Verify diagnostic tools are available (node, npx, svelte-check, tsc)

hooks.prompt: BLOCKED: You are a debugger agent — strictly read-only. Do not write or edit any files. Investigate and diagnose only. Use the engineer plugin to apply fixes.
hooks.description: Soft reminder that debugger agents must not write or edit files
Block destructive shell commands, allow read-only diagnostic commands

hooks.prompt: A diagnostic command was just run. Context: $ARGUMENTS. Evaluate whether the output contains actionable diagnostic information or if the command failed due to environment misconfiguration (missing tools, wrong Node version, missing dependencies). Respond {"ok": true} if usable, or {"ok": false, "reason": "Environment issue: <problem>"} if environment failure.
hooks.description: Detect environment issues vs application bugs in diagnostic command output

hooks.prompt: The debugger is about to stop. Review the diagnostic session: $ARGUMENTS. Verify: 1) Root cause identified (or explicitly marked Low confidence with evidence gaps), 2) Fix recipe provided with concrete steps, 3) Verification procedure included, 4) Confidence level (High/Medium/Low) explicitly stated. Respond {"ok": true} if complete, or {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing: <element>"} if incomplete.
hooks.description: Ensure every diagnostic session produces a complete report
